goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann Finanzierungs- und Haftungsfragen von Unternehmen erläutern.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native 16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Existing format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Owner funds flow toward the workshop as Eigenkapital; lender credit flows into the workshop and a separate smaller coin arrow returns to the lender. This distinguishes equity from debt without false rates or mandatory repayment of equity. The thoughtful owner and section-symbol shield introduce a liability question, not a universal guarantee of limited liability.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px owner, lender, workshop, both funding labels and opposite-direction credit/return arrows are recognizable. Promotional shop signs are decorative; the liability symbol remains large.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the arrows and holding of coins are clear, and workshop ownership/financing is easy to distinguish from purchasing a bicycle.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: No actor reads an audience-facing notebook. The workshop signs address passers-by; the lender holds a closed folder and the owner contemplates the legal symbol.
actualInspection.style: Friendly approachable comic raster, clear broad colors, large conceptual objects; no photorealistic or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The section-symbol shield is an invitation to examine liability; it must not be taught as saying that every legal form limits personal liability. No such universal claim is written in the image.
goalTextStatus: Current German competence unchanged in the E2 bilingual candidate; this image review does not attest the positive-evidence profile or bilingual description gate.
